question: What new topic is introduced for explanation to the listener?
premises: The speaker announces a new declaration.
The subject is the kalās called Vaiṣṇava.
The listener is asked to hear.
inference: The speaker now turns to explaining the kalās called Vaiṣṇava.
plain_english: Now I will speak of the kalās called Vaiṣṇava; listen, O beautiful-faced one.
